# kinsta_site_domain (Resource)

Adds a domain to a WordPress environment. Kinsta then asks for DNS records to verify the domain and point it at the site; they are exported as `verification_records` and `pointing_records` so they can be created with any DNS provider (or `kinsta_dns_record`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kinsta_site_domain" "apex" {
  environment_id = kinsta_site.blog.live_environment_id
  domain_name    = "example.com"
}

resource "kinsta_site_domain" "www" {
  environment_id = kinsta_site.blog.live_environment_id
  domain_name    = "www.example.com"
}

# Publish the records Kinsta asks for with any DNS provider, for example
# Kinsta DNS itself. They are known once the domain has been added.
locals {
  apex_records = concat(
    kinsta_site_domain.apex.verification_records,
    kinsta_site_domain.apex.pointing_records,
  )
}

output "dns_records_for_example_com" {
  value = local.apex_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) Domain to add, lowercase and without a trailing dot, e.g. `www.example.com`. It is added without a wildcard; add `www.` and other hosts as domains of their own.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment the domain is added to, e.g. `kinsta_site.example.live_environment_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Site domain ID.
- `pointing_records` (Attributes List) DNS records that point the domain at the site. Empty once the domain is verified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pointing_records))
- `uses_cloudflare_dns` (Boolean) Whether Kinsta reports the domain as using Cloudflare DNS.
- `verification_records` (Attributes List) DNS records Kinsta needs to verify ownership of the domain. Empty once the domain is verified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification_records))

<a id="nestedatt--pointing_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pointing_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `value` (String) Record value.


<a id="nestedatt--verification_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verification_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `value` (String) Record value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <environment_id>/<domain_name>.
terraform import kinsta_site_domain.apex 7d2b9c44-0000-4000-8000-000000000000/example.com
```
